tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for every site built on Flipdisc.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Panels and cards sitting on surface-000.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills for ghost controls; raised rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders. Decorative only — never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (secondary button, inputs). Meets 3:1 on surface-000 and surface-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, labels and captions on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200 (≥5.4:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: The signal fill: primary buttons and the one emphasised block per view. Pair with on-orange text. Not for text on the paper theme.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on orange-500 (6.9:1).

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange text and small marks on surface-000 and surface-100 (≥6:1 in both themes): active nav, inline highlights.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px from it.

tokens.name: housing
tokens.usage: The flip-disc board housing behind the discs. Stays black in both themes — the board is a physical object, not a themed surface.

tokens.name: disc-off
tokens.usage: A disc showing its black face. Slightly lighter than housing so the unlit grid still reads.

tokens.name: disc-white
tokens.usage: A disc flipped to its white face. The default lit colour of a DiscDisplay.

tokens.name: disc-orange
tokens.usage: A disc flipped to its fluorescent orange face. For status, alerts and the one message that must stand out.

tokens.name: board-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and labels set directly on housing (board-tone Panel), 7:1.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Read it from across the room
styles.usage: Fallback hero headline when a DiscDisplay is not used. One per page.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title under or beside the hero board.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Every disc is one CSS circle. No images, no web fonts.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero; max 60ch, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The board shows one message at a time and flips to the next.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, nav links, status words, table headers. Always set in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links; icon-to-text inside tight labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and status rows; between stacked boards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a panel's label, title and body; between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding; grid gutters; nav vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page side gutter; nav horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between hero rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top padding of the hero.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands and section dividers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels and board housings — corners stay almost square, like sheet-metal signs.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Discs and status dots only. Nothing else in the system is round.

pitch.note: Distance from one disc centre to the next in a fixed-size DiscDisplay. Each disc fills 84% of its pitch; the rest is housing.

tokens.name: pitch-sm
tokens.usage: Nav wordmark, inline tags, schedule rows.

tokens.name: pitch-md
tokens.usage: Section boards and footers.

tokens.name: pitch-lg
tokens.usage: Hero boards at a fixed size (use fit for full-width heroes).
